verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's core pitch is this exact story. It returns LLM-ready clean markdown or structured JSON from any URL (gh-9, docs-1) and claims to handle JS-heavy rendering and blocking with "no proxy headaches" across 96% of the web (gh-8). One community comment says Firecrawl lacks a proxy service (comm-3), which tempers the anti-blocking claim, though it may refer to the open-source build. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of output cleanliness, corroboration of the anti-blocking/proxy handling beyond vendor claims, clarity on whether self-hosted builds match the cloud's blocking handling.
